entities.name: Automotive industry – NADA Used Vehicle Price Index
entities.brief: Used vehicle price index from Jun 1997 to Jun 2025
entities.description: Tracks NADA used vehicle price trends and identifies pandemic-driven volatility

properties.key_insight: The index surged dramatically post-mid-2020, peaking at 210 in mid-2021, correcting by mid-2022, and hitting a new all-time high of 238.3 in June 2025

entities.name: Automotive industry – Manheim Used Vehicle Value Index
entities.brief: Used vehicle value index from Jun 1997 to Jun 2025
entities.description: Tracks Manheim index volatility and pandemic-induced price spikes

properties.key_insight: A sharp surge from ~170 to ~250-260 during mid-2020 to mid-2021, followed by a correction to 196.1 and recovery to 208.5 by June 2025
